state.goal: Determine whether the current implementation rejects oversized input before parsing.
state.claim: The current implementation rejects oversized input before parsing it.
state.current_rationale: The size guard appears before the parser call in the same control-flow path, so an oversized input should return before parsing.
state.counterclaim: The parser receives oversized input before the size guard runs.

evidence.scope: current revision; parser call immediately after guard

evidence_bases.description: The guard returns on oversized input before control reaches the following parser call.

claim_status.instructions: Assess the claim using the supplied context. Select supported, contradicted, insufficient, or conflicting.

criteria.contradicted: Evidence establishes that the claim is false.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence is not enough to decide.

decisive_basis.instructions: Select the evidence basis that directly establishes or refutes the claim. Select none when evidence is insufficient or has an unresolved conflict.

criteria.B1: E1 and E2 together establish the control-flow order.
criteria.none: No supplied basis settles the claim; evidence is insufficient or unresolved conflicting.
